name: Bättre sex
summary: Carina Berg and Carolina Gynning dive deep into everything to do with sex, love and relationships. They visit everything from exciting experts to colourful people with eye-opening specialist knowledge.

name: How Did They Build That?
summary: An investigation into the greatest man-made structures of all time, exploring how new materials and construction techniques have allowed engineers, builders and architects to work to the limits of their ability. The series focuses on the buildings that re-wrote the rulebook, and the architects, engineers and builders who made the impossible possible.

name: Agenten – pappas liv og løgner
summary: He claims he was an agent for the CIA while producing TV series with young people. Bjørn Hallstrøm tells his incredible story.

name: Yellowstone to Yosemite with Kevin Costner
summary: From Glacier Point to El Capitan, Yosemite Falls, to spectacular visuals of iconic geology, flora, and fauna of present-day Yosemite, come along with Kevin Costner for the ride.

name: Archaeology
summary: A documentary series hosted by John Rhys-Davies based on articles published in the magazine "Archaeology."

name: Brain Doctors: Inside Neurosurgery
summary: Documentary detailing daily life inside Beaumont's Neurosurgery Department.

name: Fight For Love
summary: An Binh is very self-conscious about his appearance because of burn scars from his childhood, so that he doesn't have the courage to pursue his dream of a music career and always hides behind a mask when singing. Minh Thang in contrast is a strong, open-minded guy who dares to say and do what he wants. Because of an incident, the two of them meet and so a love story begins that is both interesting, humorous, and equally touching about the journey of overcoming the limits in pursuing what they love.

name: Людмила
summary: A biopic about the life of singer Lyudmila Zykina.

previousepisode.name: The Best Man Always Wins - Sometimes

name: Rogue Claimers
summary: The extraordinary lengths insurance fraudsters go to, in order to receive bumper pay outs.

name: Batch from Scratch: Cooking for Less
summary: Can batch cooking truly transform our dinnertimes? In this brand-new series, Joe Swash and batch cooking expert Suzanne Mulholland, aka The Batch Lady, dish out a proper helping of inspiration as they help families with great time-saving tips and easy-to-follow recipes, and prove that anyone can make mealtimes stress-free, transforming family life.

name: Two Men On A Bike
summary: Two best mates, two bikes and over 200 miles of beautiful French landscape. David Baddiel and Hugh Dennis, who've been friends for 40 years, pedal through France while getting up to mischief, exploring stunning local sights and having a good chat along the way.

previousepisode.name: Подводим итоги года с Колей Редькиным, ANOIR (и не только!)

name: The Neighbourhood
summary:
The Neighbourhood will see real-life households from all walks of life move in side by side, finding themselves not only neighbours but also fierce competitors in the ultimate reality showdown.

This is a game the households will live as well as play. They'll be with each other 24/7, sleeping and eating in their houses, socialising between them - and then voting each other out. The challenges they face in public will change the dynamics behind closed doors. And to win, they'll need to defeat their neighbours, while still staying popular on the street.

In The Neighbourhood, it's not about keeping up with the Joneses - it's about beating them!

name: The Tent Mender
summary: The Tent Mender, a recovering heroin addict, returns to Skid Row after being sober for 15 years. While embarking on his journey of self-discovery, he meets and connects with some of the 14,000 people living on the streets.

name: Bikini Destinations
summary: Follow top bikini models as they set sail on a array of adventures to the world's most alluring locations. Every half hour episode will showcase glamorous swimsuit models on photo shoots around the world. From the beautiful white sand beaches of the Bahamas to the exotic islands of Tahiti... Bikini Destinations is an invitation to enchantment.

name: Pink Summer
summary: The stubborn young man Shen Jingyu is disturbed by a mysterious Chinese Valentine's Day divination magic. He could not accept that his destiny was to live temporarily in his house with his neighbor Gu Senhe who often asked him "Are you happy today?" Shen Jingyu, who had been tortured to death, spent his whole life trying to get the god of plague out of his house as soon as possible, but with little success. But for some reason, inappropriate pink bubbles always float in the air. In this way, the two teenagers spent a ridiculous and unforgettable vacation.

name: Our Chocolate Moments
summary: Seul Gi gets a job at a chocolate shop and, no matter how hard she tries, she can't seem to adapt to the environment. Despite trying to overcome her alienation with positivity, she always ends up getting hurt. One day, at Honggeumdang, a place she visited to fix a broken watch, Seul Gi falls in love with the charm of whiskey and artisanal chocolate. With this in mind, she becomes the only member of a task force that will participate in an internal Valentine's Day contest. She starts collaborating with the owner of Honggeumdang to create the best chocolate ever, but ends up having trouble finding teammates. That's when Hyun Nam, a chocolate freak, and Jeremy, an outgoing influencer, show up. Now, this trio and Mr. Hong, who is nice in a weird way, will have the chance to create the best Valentine's Day chocolate.

name: Abyss Live
summary: In the downturn of the filming industry, Yiping Film Company launched an innovative reality show "Live Cave Exploration". Famous actor Li Kaixuan and a few ordinary people attended the show, but a series of strange and horrible things happened. They were also caught in a trap set by a mysterious person. After they experienced the test of humanity, the terrible truth was slowly revealed.

name: ¡Chócalas Compayito!
summary: Compayito's artistic career is in shambles—until he meets Zacarías. He and his fun-loving family adopt Compayito and help him become famous again.

name: Home is Where the Heart Is
summary: Luke Macfarlane takes audiences inside a house that has been inherited or holds special familial meaning, and is overdue for a facelift. Alongside Designer Olivia Westbrooks, they update the home with a nod to the past.

name: Cold Blooded Liar
summary: Cold Blooded Liar is set in postcard-perfect San Diego, where strong-willed homicide detective Kit McKittrick uses her ferocious determination and heightened empathy from her foster kid background to solve the most chilling murder cases the city has ever seen. As she confronts some of the darkest corners of humanity, she meets a handsome, insightful psychologist named Sam Reeves, and together, their partnership develops into a transformative bond.

name: Funboys
summary: Funboys sees friends Callum, Jordan and Lorcan as they attempt to navigate through the hardships of life. Life is never easy for this trio of sad worms: from first girlfriends to dead pet pigs, the lads are put through the psychological ringer. But will their shared love of innocent fun and wholesome mucking about land them in hot water?

name: Spuren
summary: A young woman from southern Baden goes jogging and never comes back. After an intensive search, her body is found a few days later. Beaten to death by an unknown person. A special investigation unit is put together and begins to meticulously secure evidence - until a second murder occurs just 30 kilometers away and the team has to find out whether and how the two cases are connected. The four-part series "Spuren" is based on true events, without exploiting or dramatizing the two crimes that shook the region around Freiburg in 2016. This is not about quick sensationalism, about the bloody celebration of two terrible crimes, it is more about classic police work.

name: Running Mate
summary: Se Hoon is a model student with good grades, but an unfortunate incident on the bus one day earns him the humiliating nickname of ‘Erector.' The choir director, Won Dae, asks him to be his running mate for the upcoming student council election. Needing to rehabilitate his image, Se Hoon agrees, only to find out that he is Won Dae's twelfth running mate. With his pride bruised, Se Hoon decides to join Sang Hyun, a walking luxury man known as the local social butterfly.

name: A Day with Dana
summary: A British chat show hosted by Dana Rosemary Scallon.

name: The Next Level
summary: Berlin, the final stop on a honeymoon trip around the world. Josh and Zofia from New York are looking for the ultimate kick: a night in the techno club "Reaktor"! Hard door, powerful bass - finally inside! Suddenly she disappears into the crowd: an emergency text message from the club team and a dramatic night in hospital follow. In the morning, Josh learns of his wife's death. Rosa hears about the tragedy in the waiting room. Now the journalist wants to know what happened.

name: NBA - Mesél a Pálya
summary: The history of the NBA is full of legends, perhaps a lifetime would not be enough to tell them all, but Péter Scherer will try. In the Sport TV series Mesél a Pálya, he tells us stories about 10 excellent basketball players for 10 episodes. He does it all the way only he knows how.

name: Cult of Fear: Asaram Bapu
summary: Uncover the alleged crimes, deceit, violence and manipulations of a once-revered spiritual leader, Asaram.

name: Сеанс с Кашпировским
summary: 1987. On the air of the program "Vzglyad", in front of the whole country, journalist Vadim Belozerov has his arm pierced with a long "Gypsy" needle. At the same time, he continues to host the program as if nothing had happened. Not only TV viewers are surprised: Belozerov's colleagues know that the journalist is deathly afraid of any injections and cannot stand even the slightest pain. Belozerov explains: he was anesthetized remotely, with a look, by a guest in the studio, psychotherapist Anatoly Kashpirovsky. A few months later, in March 1988, on the air of the same "Vzglyad", Dr. Kashpirovsky will conduct a unique teleconference: he will anesthetize a woman who is on the operating table many kilometers away, in Kyiv. The experiment will be repeated in 1989, this time with two patients at once. And on October 9, 1989, the first "Kashpirovsky Session" was broadcast. Today it seems that these sessions lasted for several years, but in fact, there were only 8 episodes. This was enough for them to become iconic, and the doctor's phrases, for example, "I give the order!" - winged. Kashpirovsky himself remained one of the most famous, mysterious and controversial figures of the perestroika era. In the program, Anatoly Kashpirovsky appears in a new capacity: now he is not only a psychotherapist, capable of making you forget about pain with his gaze or giving a "order for good". He is the chief judge and expert in the field of the unknown and inexplicable, everything that goes beyond human understanding. Psychics, telepathy and telekinesis, ghosts, dream mysteries, damage and the evil eye, signs of fate - all these topics excite many, but cannot always be explained by modern science. In each episode of the program, the doctor, having chosen one of these topics, will conduct a comprehensive investigation. Mysterious stories, eyewitness accounts and witnesses of incredible events flock to the mobile headquarters of Anatoly Kashpirovsky. He studies them, evaluates their veracity and tries to separate the facts from harmless fiction or disguised fraud. It is not easy to make the doctor believe: he rejects many stories that are convincing to the uninitiated right away, while others he goes to study personally. On the instructions of Anatoly Kashpirovsky, unique experiments are carried out in real time in front of TV viewers, and he himself takes direct part in some of them.

name: Натали и Александр
summary: The love story of Natalia Goncharova and Alexander Pushkin was short, but intense, passionate and, ultimately, sad. The plot centers on the fate of a woman who became the wife and muse of a brilliant poet, the mother of his four children, a socialite and an apple of discord. She dreamed of simple human happiness, but her love went down in history.

name: La vida breve
summary: Like any young man, Louis is about to experience great changes. He is married to an unknown cousin and is to inherit the throne of Spain. In the middle of the 18th century, this would be a happy episode in the life of any prince, but things are not going to be easy for Louis. With a rebellious wife, an alienated father and a conspiring stepmother, Louis I has to begin his reign. Luckily for him, the problems will soon end.

name: Oligarques, le gang de Poutine
summary: A handful of businessmen control Russian industry and especially the lucrative oil and gas sector, vital to the country's post-soviet economy and war effort in Ukraine. This series tells the story of this fabulously wealthy group of men who have shaped their country but only survive if they remain in Vladimir Putin's favour…

name: Road to Gymkhana Grid Profiles
summary: Gymkhana Grid profiles tells powerful emotional stories from a diverse range of drivers and what it takes to compete at the highest level.

name: Fear
summary: Excited to make a fresh start away from London, Martyn and Rebecca move into a beautiful house in Glasgow with their two young children. At first the new home seems idyllic, but when their neighbour Jan makes unnerving comments to Rebecca it turns out to be the start of something far more intimidating. Facing accusations that are every parent's worst nightmare, and with the authorities refusing to step in, Martyn and Rebecca feel they have nowhere to turn to for help.

name: Harlem Ice
summary: Harlem Ice is a five-part documentary series following the coaches and girls of Figure Skating in Harlem as they prepare for competitions, performances, and a life-changing global experience. Through their eyes, we experience the highs and lows of the Figure Skating in Harlem organization's season and the unique experiences they have as girls of color breaking the "ice ceiling" and gaining access to a global stage.

name: Entre Paredes
summary: Marga and Martín happen to meet on a dating app, unaware they are neighbors. Although they have an instant connection, they decide not to pursue their romance following the unsaid rule: "one should never date one's neighbor." However, over time, these two will find it hard to hide their feelings behind the wall that keeps them apart.

name: Par de Ideotas
summary: Vadhir and José Eduardo Derbez open a pop-up bar together, but opening a business for the first time is anything but easy! With the pressure of trying to make it a success, the brothers work hard but not without crazy and unexpected issues!

name: Pamela's Cooking with Love
summary: This series follows television & film phenomenon Pamela Anderson as she takes on her latest passion - cooking. Join Pamela as she invites some of today's most sought-after and buzz-worthy chefs to join her on a beautiful rural property on Vancouver Island, where together they'll prepare delicious plant-based meals for Pamela to enjoy with her family and friends.

name: Sounds Black
summary: The new Canadian-original documentary series Sounds Black (4×60) from Corus Entertainment examines the origins and impact of Black Music in Canada. Directed by award-winning filmmaker Cazhhmere Downey, with contributions from Canadian music luminaries, the four episodes take viewers on a journey through Black Canadian music's tangled diasporic roots and its road to international dominance.

name: Афродеревня
summary: A comedy series about what happens when a group of Africans unexpectedly arrives in a remote Russian village, and on the initiative of a local girl who has returned from Africa. The village head, Anatoly Stolbov, who is used to spending budgets and avoiding change, finds himself in a difficult situation: in order to retain power, he will have to help the Africans integrate. But his plan falls apart when he learns that his daughter is going to marry one of them.

name: Экстрасенсы-детективы
summary:
Studio producer "WeiT Media". Originally filmed for the Russian TV channel "ДТВ" in 2010, but was not shown on air.

When traditional investigation methods reach a dead end, professionals can look for any, at first glance, fantastic clues and even turn to psychics for help. To believe or not to believe them? This question arises in each episode, during the investigation of each dramatic case - until non-standard methods help to unravel the most complex crime. Each episode of the series "Psychics - Detectives" is the story of one difficult criminal offense, which is investigated in parallel by an investigator and a psychic. Psychics do not immediately see the full picture of what happened, but they provide the investigation with information obtained through visions, contact with the personal belongings of the victim, working with photographs. Receiving additional and much-needed information, the investigator can expand the circle of suspects, find additional evidence and solve the crime.

name: Сверхъестественные
summary:
Our country is a huge market for paid magic services. Neither marriages nor business deals are concluded without consulting an astrologer or psychic. Hundreds of witchcraft ads are published in newspapers, and the Internet is full of websites of hereditary shamans and fortune tellers. But how does the magic industry actually work, where quite real, and at the same time, considerable money is involved?

We will show the whole truth about otherworldly trade! The famous mentalist Lior Suchard and a psychologist-reporter with 15 years of experience Angela Boskis will reveal the secrets of a profitable business. How much does a miracle cost in modern packaging? What is the basis - the desire to help or the thirst for profit? How to distinguish a real psychic from a skilled charlatan? And do shamans have quality certificates?

Lior Suchard and Angela Boskis will find real, practicing magicians and test their skills in practice. No tricks or special effects!

To believe or not to believe is up to you.

name: Robin Hood
summary:
Robin Hood is described as a sweeping, romantic adventure, a modern take of the classic tale that brings historical authenticity, psychological depth, and a heightened focus on the relationship between Rob and Marian.

In the series, following the Norman invasion of England, Rob – a Saxon forester's son – and Marian, the daughter of a Norman lord – fall in love and work together to fight for justice and freedom. As Rob rises as the leader of a band of rebel outlaws, Marian infiltrates the power at court, as both work together to thwart royal corruption and bring peace to the land.

name: The Successor
summary: The Successor (also known as The Next Uri Geller) is an Israeli television competition program in which contestants perform acts of mentalism, illusion, escapism and other feats before a live studio audience. The acts are judged by a panel, with votes from the studio audience and viewers at home. The original program was created by Uri Geller in 2006 for Israeli television, with Geller also acting as one of the judges on the show.

name: Феномен
summary: There is a new spectacular show on the Russia TV channel! 10 participants of the project, each of whom is endowed with incredible paranormal abilities, will take part in the tests for the title of the best! All of them passed a difficult casting and are now ready to surprise everyone with their unique abilities and show real miracles! Uri Geller is the main character of the program. This is a man with truly outstanding strength: he easily bends steel spoons without touching them, and can fix broken appliances in any home from the TV screen. Invited stars will take part in amazing experiments, who, along with all the other guests of the studio, will become witnesses of incredible, inexplicable events.

name: Факты
summary: A show where interesting people discuss interesting facts.

name: The Seized Destiny
summary: At Cheng Yan's advancement ceremony, her martial brother Cheng Tian forced her into dual cultivation. In despair, Cheng Yan self-destructed her inner core but was saved by her contracted magical beast, Chen. She later discovered that Cheng Tian's body had been taken over by the ancient magical beast, Sha. Determined to avenge herself, she began her quest for revenge. Cheng Yan refined an ancient artifact to restore her inner core but was poisoned in the process, leaving her with little time to live. She chose to marry Chen but sent him back to the demon realm the day after their wedding and was killed shortly after. Enraged, Chen returned to Longqiu only to find that Cheng Yan had been reborn as Lu Ming, an immortal. Using Lu Ming's identity, Cheng Yan attempted to reseal Sha but was exposed. She and Chen ultimately joined forces in a final battle, sealing Sha for good and restoring peace to the three realms.

name: Beasts & Witches
summary: Throughout history, we've been haunted by the owl's screech, the enigmatic world of bats, the hidden realm of snakes, and the sinister reputation of toads and witches. While some might argue these fears are antiquated, the opposite holds true. Centuries of superstitions have etched these anxieties into our very genes, resulting in animals becoming unjust targets through hunting, extermination, or labeling them as pests.

name: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
summary: Million Dollar Zombie Flips follows James Dainard and his team as they hunt for, fix, and flip zombie houses in the Seattle area. In each episode, James brings the cash and teams up with a rookie flipper who finds a dilapidated house and together, they attempt to turn it into a stunning million-dollar home. Following James' plan, the flipping partner is in charge of the renovation process and if all goes smoothly, they split the profit 50/50. However, if the newbie can't meet the team's standards, James will take over and keep the full profit for himself. With millions of dollars on the line, do these real-estate newbies have what it takes to turn big bucks in the high-stakes world of flipping?

name: Sin City Gigolo: A Murder in Las Vegas
summary: Sin City Gigolo: A Murder in Las Vegas which follows the criminal investigation of a former GIGOLOS cast member who was arrested for killing a young female client.

name: Single Black Female
summary: Single Black Female follows Monica, who's reeling from the death of her beloved father and a difficult breakup, ready to move forward with her life as she tries to land the new hosting job for an afternoon talk show. When the station hires her a new assistant, Simone, the two quickly become close friends as Simone moves in next door and completely immerses herself in Monica's life. But underneath her sweet exterior, Simone harbours a dark secret and as time goes on cracks in her façade begin to appear. Monica decides to sever ties once and for all with Simone, but Simone has other plans and is determined to take over Monica's life for good.

previousepisode.name: Single Black Female 3: The Final Chapter

name: CTV News Special
summary: Special news coverage from the CTV News team.

previousepisode.name: Prince Harry and the Canadian Heroes

name: Hanomansing Tonight
summary: CBC today announced that veteran broadcaster and award-winning journalist Ian Hanomansing will host a new CBC News daily primetime program rooted in Western Canada, HANOMANSING TONIGHT, live from CBC Vancouver beginning Tuesday, February 18. Offering breaking and live news coverage with the professionalism and personality that he is known for.

name: Kursk: 10 Days that Shaped Putin
summary: Set against a ticking clock, this two-part Sky History commission tells an urgent story of political drama, military bravery, and loss in a defining moment in the history of modern Russia. Kursk: 10 Days That Shaped Putin is a dramatic and forensic examination of events that took place in August 2000, after an explosion onboard the Kursk submarine trapped a group of survivors at the bottom of the Barents Sea. Why did the Russians take so long to accept international assistance? How did this crisis and subsequent reporting change Russia and importantly, how would it shape Putin's own trajectory as the new President of Russia? The film hears first-hand testimony from those involved from President Bill Clinton to families of the submariners and an American submarine Commander who witnessed it first hand, taking us behind the closed doors of the White House, and below the surface with rescue divers who finally make it down to the stricken submarine.

name: Taylor Lautner: Werewolf Hunter
summary: After wrapping the final Twilight film, Taylor Lautner vanished from the spotlight. Fans speculated, tabloids theorized—but the truth is wilder than fiction. Taylor wasn't just taking a mental health break. He was preparing for his real calling... Taylor Lautner: Werewolf Hunter. Playing himself, Taylor is drawn into a secret society of werewolf trackers who need his unique expertise. As he navigates his double life—Hollywood actor by day, supernatural warrior by night—Taylor must wrestle with the ultimate irony: fighting the very creatures that made him famous. Between saving the world, reviving his career, and falling in love, he faces the ultimate question—what happens when your biggest role becomes your greatest enemy?

name: Gabriel and the Guardians
summary: Gabriel, a celestial guardian, is sent into the dark realm of Ara to recover the Eternal Seed—a powerful artifact stolen from the celestial realm. As he embarks on his mission, he joins forces with Nok, a giant hunter seeking redemption, and Namay'ah, a mysterious alchemist princess. Together, they face treacherous lands, ancient evils, and secrets that could reshape their destinies. In a battle between light and chaos, they must find the strength to restore order before it's too late.

name: Le Refuge d'Audrey
summary: Le Refuge d'Audrey is a French-Canadian-Spanish animated series produced by Watch Next Media, Image-In Atlantique, and Peekaboo Animation. The series follows the daily life of a seven-year-old girl named Audrey, who lives in a sanctuary dedicated to endangered species. As she grows up in this environment, Audrey and her best friend Tommy continuously discover new animals and learn to coexist with them.

name: A Woman of Substance
summary: We meet the magnetic Emma Harte in 1911, as an impoverished, ambitious maid in Yorkshire, England, and follow her irresistible and dizzying climb to become the world's richest woman, gazing down on her sprawling empire from a luxury New York penthouse. The background to Emma Harte's rags-to-riches rise is the tale of women through the 20th century, as Emma defies the expectations of her society, fearlessly challenging the roles she's given, smashing glass ceilings, and never, ever deviating from her masterplan: Get to the top. Whatever it takes. A housemaid-turned-mogul, daughter, mother, lover, fighter and a 20th century feminist icon who refused to know her ‘place', Emma Harte returns to Channel 4 once again to delight and scandalise audiences.

name: Pierre
summary: West London duty solicitor Pierre is a force of nature: charming and funny, a glamorous character in an unglamorous profession, juggling the pressures of his job, a fragile personal life and just keeping his head above water financially. His resilience is tested when he begins investigating the suspicious death of a young black client, Michael. As Pierre challenges the police's portrayal of Michael as a criminal, he unravels a chilling web of institutional corruption… When you come at the system, the system comes at you…

name: Maya
summary: Leaving their lives in London behind, Anna and her teenage daughter Maya must take on new identities and relocate to a small rural town. As they try to adjust to their new reality, the trauma of their past continues to haunt them and the sinister presence of two hitmen leaves a trail of unease as they search for the missing mother and daughter. As the walls close in on them it becomes clear that the dangerous figure from their past is still a looming threat.

name: A Secret to Die For
summary: Follow a trail of secrets so dark and twisted that keeping them hidden becomes more than an obsession; it's a motive for murder. Delve into the shocking true stories behind tragic deaths no one, least of all the victims, could have seen coming.

name: The Rachel Incident
summary:
The Rachel Incident is aching with unrequited love, shot through with delicious, sparkling humour about friends, lovers, Ireland in chaos, and a young woman desperately trying to manage all three…

Rachel is a student working at a bookstore when she meets James, and it is love at first sight. Effervescent and insistently heterosexual, James soon invites Rachel to be his roommate, and the two begin a friendship that changes the course of both their lives forever.  Together, they run riot through the streets of Cork City, trying to maintain a bohemian existence while the threat of the financial crash looms before them. When Rachel falls in love with her married professor, Dr Fred Byrne, James helps her devise a reading at their local bookstore, with the goal that she might seduce him afterwards. But Fred has other desires. So begins a series of secrets and compromises that intertwine the fates of James, Rachel, Fred, and Fred's glamorous, well-connected wife Deenie.

name: Falling
summary: Anna is a devoted nun who has spent most of her adult life in a convent whilst David, a catholic priest, is at the top of his game, committed to his work in the church and the Bristol community that surrounds it. Neither are expected to fall in love… However, when they do, both Anna and David are forced to wrestle with what it means for them, their vows, and their relationship with God.

name: Западная трибуна
summary: A documentary blockbuster about the structure of elite European football through portraits of the strongest Russian players

previousepisode.name: Увидеть Париж и выиграть Лигу чемпионов

name: Krong Karawek
summary: When the "family diamond machine " disappeared like a puzzle Causing one family to face serious allegations that it is "the thief " the only way to recover dignity and find the truth Is to reveal the mystery of "the Wakefield House " that is full of secrets and clues waiting to solve the mystery.

previousepisode.name: "อดิศร" มีปากเสียงกับ "โฉมฉาย"

name: Mia Taeng
summary: Kongkai lives his life as a playboy, so his mother wants him to get married with a girl who can make him better. So, she forces him to marry with Arunprapai, a good girl she finds for him. Arunprapai accepts to marry with a guy who she doesn't love to avoid the rumor that she commits adultery with Phuchong, her ex-boyfriend who is going to have a baby with another girl by accident. However, Kongkai and Arunprapai's marriage life is not smooth because Kongkai also has girlfriend named Prungchat and she wants to get him back.

name: Saigo no Jugyou -Ikinokotta Mono Dake ga Sotsugyou-
summary: On the eve of graduation, students are locked in the music room and told they must kill each other to survive. A music teacher, seeking revenge for the death of his fiancée, transforms into a "mad teacher."

name: Dog Days Out
summary: Adorable dogs let their imaginations run wild on zany adventures with their favorite toys in this non-dialogue series fueled by furry fun.

name: L'intruse
summary:
Paula, 40, is nearing the end of her maternity leave. She has to return to work in a few days. But she's not ready. Orso, her youngest, has exhausted her, not to mention her two older children.

With her husband Jérôme, she recruits Tess, an au pair... Tess seems perfect. She's a rare gem. But Paula quickly feels uncomfortable with the young girl. Yet she's the only one. Everyone adores Tess... But she notices changes in her home and the increasing number of incidents that make her seem like a bad mother... She senses something is wrong, but no one believes her when she says Tess wants to harm them... She's told it's probably her baby blues that's making her paranoid. Or does Paula herself have things to hide?

As for Tess, she didn't end up there by chance. What is she looking for when she enters this home?

When a stranger invades your privacy, you have to weigh the risks and consequences. A family is often tiring and exhausting, yet it's when you risk losing it that you realise its full importance.

name: The Boys from Brazil
summary: Lieberman, a famous Nazi hunter, is drawn to investigate a conspiracy spun to him by a young Nazi hunter. Lieberman is highly skeptical of the young man's claims that notorious Dr. Josef Mengele is in Paraguay, starting on a diabolical plan to reestablish the Third Reich through a cloning plan put in place after Germany lost World War II. When the young Nazi hunter is killed, Lieberman heads to Paraguay to uncover a truth that turns out to be horrific.

name: Адъютанты любви
summary: 1800 year. Europe is on the eve of big changes. Napoleon Bonaparte is preparing for great deeds, but family "battles" interfere with this.

name: Don't Leave Me
summary: Gu Man Qing couldn't stand her husband Shen Jun's long-term domestic violence, so she faked her death to escape. Later, she met the plastic surgeon Wen Yi Huai and begged him to change her face. Wen Yi Huai agreed and asked Gu Man Qing to pretend to be his deceased wife. Unexpectedly, Shen Jun found out, and the three of them started a thrilling game of chase and escape.

name: Xu Ni Yi Chang Bei Huan
summary: The love story of an ascetic director and a poor student

name: World Upside Down
summary: He Yan, the president of Fanxing Group, was in a car accident on the anniversary of her father's death. After being disfigured, her fiancé Yu Ge seized power. She asked Lin Xiao, who looked similar to her, to pretend to be her, trying to find evidence of Yu Ge's guilt. In the process, Yu Ge developed feelings for Lin Xiao, and Lin Xiao gradually wavered in their relationship. As the truth was revealed, He Yan's revenge plan, Yu Ge's life secrets, and Lin Xiao's life secrets intertwined, triggering a series of emotional entanglements and fierce conflicts.

name: Women who act coquettishly have the best luck
summary: After her boyfriend cheats, a girl proposes a fictitious marriage to her childhood friend to participate in a talk show about love

name: Stealing Beauty
summary: Jewelry designer Xie Qing Han was trapped by Qiao Yi Zhou's false "favor" trap. She constantly compromised for love, stayed away from society, and lost herself, becoming a "gunman" used by her boyfriend Qiao Yi Zhou. But after meeting Shao Qing Yun, Xie Qing Han gradually realized that her cognition had always been narrow and wrong. Normal feelings should be mutual understanding and mutual achievement, rather than gaining pleasure and achievements by oppressing each other. Under Shao Qing Yun's strong intervention, Xie Qing Han kept growing. She re-engaged with society, resumed work, and restarted her beloved career.

name: La Promesa
summary:
1913. The whole world is on the brink of the abyss, but there are havens of peace isolated from the conflicts. Like the La Promesa Palace, in the valley of Los Pedroches, property of the Marquises of Luján, one of the largest landowners in the country.

Can love quench the thirst for revenge? Could you forget those who ruined your life? The murderers of your mother? Those who made your brother disappear? A woman, revenge and a great love story are the ingredients of La Promesa.

name: Everybody's Live with John Mulaney
summary: The Comeback Kid. Baby J. Andrew Glouberman. John Mulaney has many names in the Netflix universe, and he's about to claim one more: live variety talk show host.

previousepisode.name: What is On The Minds of Teens?

name: Cold Case Files: Dead West
summary: In the ruggedness of the American West, death is always a shadow over the shoulder: a grizzly bear encounter, an avalanche, or a bite from a rattlesnake can change everything in an instant; and those are just the natural threats; if one wants to get away with murder, the mountain ranges of the West may be the perfect place to do it; peering into the dusty files found in the back country sheriff's offices and highlighting the cases that were deemed unsolvable because the crime scene was too rugged, too remote, or the victim assumed too hard to find; despite the odds in this landscape, justice prevails.

name: Stadium Lockup
summary: Stadium game day in Cleveland, Ohio, is an electric, cathartic, emotional experience shared by 67,000 die-hard fans coming together inside this city within a city. Protecting them is a highly trained force of nearly 1,000 brave and dedicated men and women from law enforcement, multiple private security agencies and medics from the nearby hospital. This new series provides unprecedented access to the stadium's command center where more than 500 CCTV cameras are monitored in real time. Whether it's large-scale brawls, lifesaving resuscitations, or heartfelt reunions with missing children — viewers get a behind-the-scenes look, as officers and medics are dispatched on hundreds of calls including instances of fans breaking the strict code of conduct, resulting in ejection or worse — a one-way ticket to Stadium Lockup.

name: Yes, Chef!
summary: Yes, Chef! blends the high-stakes thrill of a cooking competition with the raw emotion of personal transformation as it delves into the powerful personalities attracted to the chaotic culinary lifestyle. The series puts 12 highly skilled chefs, who have been nominated by their bosses, co-workers, friends and even family, through the ultimate test. These rising stars all have natural talent, but their egos, intensity, stubbornness or short fuses are holding them back from reaching their full potential. The chefs will have to prove they have the culinary chops and the right attitude to make it to the end. The chef who handles the heat, impressing with both their food and teamwork while improving their behavior, will take home the $250,000 grand prize, provided by granola brand Purely Elizabeth.

name: First 48: Wrong Place, Wrong Time
summary: Detectives in major cities in the United States race against the clock in the wake of homicides, knowing that if they don't find a lead within the first 48 hours, their chances of solving a case are cut in half. The programme shows how detectives use forensic evidence and witness interviews to help identify suspects.

name: Force of Nature
summary: Force of Nature is a groundbreaking series filmed over three years, revealing how nature is fighting back against today's extreme weather. Witness the scale and ferocity of nature's most powerful forces - from hurricanes and flash floods to droughts and bushfires - and discover the ingenious ways nature endures, adapts and prevails against these new extremes. Through the eyes of heroic animal characters, this heartfelt, dramatic and inspiring series shows how the natural world is rising to the challenge. There has never been a more pressing and relevant natural history series.

name: 10 News First Special
summary: Special news coverage from the Network Ten team.

name: Accused: Did I Do It?
summary: Accused: Did I Do It? follows the high-stakes stories of individuals who stood trial and are facing charges for serious offenses such as first-degree murder, manslaughter, domestic terrorism and aggravated assault. Every piece of evidence may lead to an answer, but the truth is never quite clear until the final moment of reveal. Intimately filmed in prisons and homes across the US, the location of the accused is kept a mystery as the story unfolds. Key turning points, evidence, and decisions that led to charges and eventual verdicts are pieced together with nail-biting testimony, explosive trial footage, and interviews with their defense attorneys and family members.

name: Hockey Night in Canada on CBC: After Hours
summary: Wrapping up the night with post-game interviews and analysis.

name: Tip Toe
summary: Tense thriller from Russell T Davies, with Alan Cumming and David Morrissey. An ordinary Manchester suburb becomes a minefield of lies and violence when Leo gives neighbour Clive his spare key.

name: The Inheritance
summary:
Twelve strangers arrive at a grand English country estate, lured by one irresistible opportunity: to inherit a chunk of a vast fortune. The fortune belonged to a glamorous benefactor known only as The Deceased who has left video messages for the players from beyond the grave. 

To release money from The Inheritance, players must work as a team to complete a series of challenges. The better they perform; the more money is released. But The Deceased had a wicked sense of humour and one ruthless condition: to win the game they must persuade all others that only they should be entrusted with the money. 

It's a game of wit, willpower, persuasion, and betrayal, where it's not about who deserves the money, but who's willing to outplay, out-charm, and out-scheme the competition to claim it.

name: The Hunt
summary:
The Hunt - a heart-pounding, high-stakes game of predator versus prey, where there is only one rule – hunt or be hunted.

Deep in a vast unforgiving forest, contestants are dropped into the ultimate real-world game of hide and seek - where losing means walking away with nothing and winning could mean pocketing up to £100,000. Surviving the game isn't about being the fastest. It's about being the smartest.

name: All Fours
summary: All Fours, Miranda July's propulsive, sexy and irreverent novel about a woman at a turning point in her life who embarks on a journey of self-discovery and sexual awakening.

name: Forensics NZ
summary: Focusing on real-life cases in New Zealand, forensic science is combined with clever investigation techniques to unlock what really happened in criminal mysteries.

name: Pyaar Testing
summary: Dhruv and Amrita, potential marriage partners, decided to live together before the wedding to test their compatibility. As they spend time together, the question arises that whether they develop romantic feelings between them.

name: Deep Affection Eyes
summary: Ye Meng's journey to the north ended and then she returned to her hometown to get married. Who would have expected that on the wedding night, Ye Meng would go back to the north. The man sent her ten messages in a row while holding a bachelor party at home. Ye Meng completely ignored him, blocked him, letting him cause whatever troubles he wanted. To force Ye Meng to return to Y City, this young man used all kinds of tricks, including divorce papers, notices of terminal illness, etc. However, Ye Meng remained totally unmoved and kept prospering in Beijing.

name: Física o Química: La nueva generación
summary: High school drama following diverse teenagers as they join a support group after a student's tragic loss. Despite differing values, they find self-discovery and shared passion for life and love through their confessions.

name: Хороший гол
summary: Microphone and camera on KHL referees. Showing the best European hockey from the first person

name: 20 spørsmål
summary: A quiz competition for the quick-witted. The panel has 20 questions to find the solution to the task!

name: Arena Football One
summary: Viewers will be treated to this weekly live showcase of the league's top teams and star players, and fans can expect thrilling matchups, innovative camera angles, and insightful commentary from industry experts.

previousepisode.name: SW Kansas Storm at Salina Liberty

name: Kill Jackie
summary: Jackie Price has been living a luxurious existence for the last twenty years – travelling the world, selling fine art using sophisticated tax loopholes, and, above all, trying to stay anonymous after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life starts to feel a little boring, it takes a sudden lethal turn when she discovers The Seven Demons, a squad of the world's most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her. Assuming someone from her past is behind it, Jackie unleashes her old instincts and embarks on a wild, dangerous game plan: to take down The Demons one by one before they kill her. However, she soon realises her own demons are much more terrifying than the ruthless killers on her trail... and her buried secrets ultimately lead her much closer to home, with surprising consequences.

name: Accidental Firing
summary: To avenge his parents, Lu Yan gradually advanced his plan. But Mu Lan kept sabotaging it. Upon deeper investigation, Lu Yan discovered that she was the girl he had a crush on in childhood. From being adversaries to allying, they targeted the fake "Lu Changhe." But "Lu Changhe" had already seen through all their moves...

name: Desiguales
summary:
An innovative talk show that offers a multifaceted and revealing perspective on current affairs, highlighting the female angle with five participants from different generations, styles, nationalities, and cultures.

Desiguales is known for its diverse approach, with lively discussions on current topics, entertainment news, and personal stories from the hosts and their guests. With its relaxed and energetic style, the show has become a favorite of viewers seeking an entertaining and light experience. Additionally, it has been praised for its close connection with its audience, thanks to the blend of humor, personality, and current pop culture topics.

name: Bravo's Love Hotel
summary: Bravo's Love Hotel brings together some of "The Real Housewives" franchise fan favorites for the ultimate luxurious getaway in the hopes of finding true love. The ladies will head to the Grand Velas Boutique Hotel in Los Cabos, Mexico, where they will mix and mingle with a group of eligible bachelors, each vying for the chance to win their hearts and put the "wives" back in "Housewives."

name: Twitter: Breaking the Bird
summary: Twitter: Breaking the Bird features new interviews with co-founder and former CEO Ev Williams and co-founder Biz Stone, who share their personal experiences of how a group of idealistic friends set out to build a digital utopia, and how that vision morphed into the platform now owned by Elon Musk. Featuring additional insight from numerous Twitter employees from the rank and file to the C-suite, and analysis from journalists like Kara Swisher who have been covering the company since day one, Twitter: Breaking the Bird is the definitive tale of the corporate clashes, revolving door leadership and tech bro hubris hidden behind the scenes at this once-trailblazing company.

name: Три плюс три
summary: The Klyachev family lives in the picturesque town of the Golden Ring: writer Anton Pavlovich, his son Leonid, a blacksmith, and grandson Prometheus, who works as a lifeguard. The Larin family lives in the same city: taxi driver Valentina Petrovna, her daughter is a tour guide Sveta, and her granddaughter is an artist Julia. Prometheus is convinced that Julia is a fraud. He uncovers one of her scams and turns her over to the police. Their meeting becomes fateful not only for the characters themselves, but also for their relatives, who no longer hoped for personal happiness.

name: Дорогой Вилли
summary: The 1960s. Soviet intelligence learns about US plans to strike from military bases located in Germany. Brezhnev understands that a retaliatory ultimatum will be the beginning of a nuclear catastrophe, so he decides to take the risk of concluding a secret agreement with German Chancellor Willy Brandt. To do this, he recruits former front-line soldier Vyacheslav Vardanov and German journalist Valery Pletnev. Together, they will complete an unprecedented mission, on the success of which the fate of the entire world depends.

name: На льду
summary: Ksenia, a famous figure skater in the past, returns to her hometown to uncover the mystery of the death of her figure skating partner Alexei, which occurred 10 years ago. She gets a job as a coach at her former sports school and soon realizes that nothing has changed here: intrigues are still being wove, hidden games are being played, and in every family where young figure skaters grow up, their skeletons are hidden in the closet. The children face the same problems as Ksenia once did, and the girl realizes that all this can lead to a terrible tragedy again. In addition, the head coach of the school is still the domineering Alevtina, who knows exactly how Alexey died...

name: Интересное положение
summary: There is a little-known medical fact: a woman can give birth to twins from different men. Lada finds itself in just such a situation. A guy leaves a girl on the anniversary of a relationship right in bed. Together with her friend, the heroine goes to drink down her grief at the club. There, she very conveniently meets an old acquaintance who is ready to heal her mental wound. After a while, Lada finds out that she is pregnant. Now the future mother of two little angels needs to find out who their father is. Or the fathers…

name: Muero por Marilú
summary: Marilú is a secretary who inherits a percentage of Funerales Garza Gallardo from her boss, Don Anselmo. This percentage makes her the partner of Matías: Don Anselmo's son and heir, who is prevented from selling the business by his new partner.

name: Murder in the Skies: Who Downed MH17?
summary: July 2014. When Malaysian Airlines flight MH17 crashes in Ukraine, killing all 298 people on board, the circumstances are shrouded in mystery. With a regional war beginning to rage around the crash site, disinformation is everywhere. Western governments are left scrabbling for detail while one civilian is leading the hunt for answers – Dad of two and amateur blogger Eliot Higgins. And with an unlikely team of online detectives by his side, he's ready to fight all the way to the truth. Combining the geopolitical stakes of NAVALNY and LOCKERBIE with the pulsating internet sleuthing of DON'T F*** WITH CATS, this gripping documentary series follows the 21st Century's most politically significant plane crash - an international David vs. Goliath narrative following a bunch of unexpected heroes who risked their lives to fight for justice.

name: Georgia Harrison: Porn, Power, Profit
summary:
Georgia Harrison dives into the secretive world of online porn to find out how this industry works and how non-consensual pornographic images are being created and used to help drive profits and power to individuals.

The world of online porn is not easy to escape, so how does it make money and who are the people profiting from a kind of footage where little accountability is involved?

name: My Unpredictable Lover
summary: Su Xiao Zhao, a commoner-born but exceptionally talented cook, accidentally wandered into a hunting ground while gathering ingredients. By chance, she saved Third Young Master Zhao Han, who was targeted by assassins, and thus became entangled in the undercurrents of the struggle for the city lord's position...

name: Danske spioner i den kolde krig
summary: Matilde Kimer investigates how Denmark conducted espionage during the Cold War. For the first time, FE has allowed former employees to break their lifelong silence and tell the story from the inside.

name: Требуется мама в семью с тремя детьми
Shiboyugi: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
summary: At just seventeen, Yuki is a professional death game player. She's survived enough rounds to know that survival is calculation, not luck—and that failure is final. For most players, the games are a nightmare with no escape. For Yuki, they're simply business. Yet in a world where rooms turn into graves and every choice could be her last, even experience offers no protection.

name: 3-nen A-gumi: Ima kara Minasan Dake no, Sotsugyoshiki Desu
summary: Mini-series continuing the story of "Mr. Hiiragi's Homeroom". It shows events regarding a special graduation ceremony only for the students of Hiiragi-sensei.

name: Good Day
summary:
Good Day is a music project where G-Dragon collaborates with people from various fields to create the song of the year. As the producer, G-Dragon will take the lead in crafting music, turning different individuals' stories into songs, all while showcasing the creative process through a reality variety format.

Confirmed guests include top actors Hwang Jung-min and Kim Go-eun, who joined the show after resonating with its concept. Additionally, the famous "88-line" stars—Kim Soo-hyun, Jung Hae-in, Im Si-wan, Kwanghee, and Lee Soo-hyuk—are set to appear, heightening anticipation. Other big names include SEVENTEEN's unit BSS (Seungkwan, DK, Hoshi), TV personalities Hong Jin-kyung and Kian84, as well as celebrity chef Ahn Sung-jae, all adding to the excitement for the show's premiere.

name: Settle Down
summary: Mason is an expert on queer relationships and a matchmaker with a booming success rate. When it comes to love, he knows all...except why his own relationship is on the rocks.

name: Caged Bird
summary: The drama portrays the decade long relationship between a student and his teacher.

name: My Sweetheart Jom
summary: When he gets tangled up with a mafia boss's son's girlfriend and ends up in a scuffle, young Yothin needs to find a safe place. Instead of sending him overseas, his father decides to send him to the countryside! There, he stays in Bang Pho under the care of subdistrict headman, a close friend of his father. He's also under the watchful eye of the village headman who happens to be the subdistrict headman's grandson and is overseeing his probation. As Yothin spends more time with Jomkhwan, his perception of the village headman begins gradually to change.

name: Bird in the hands of a paranoid
summary: To pay off her debts, she signed an agreement with him to become his mistress. How long will it take? Maybe forever

name: Britain on Film with Tony Robinson
summary: This unique series narrated by Sir Tony Robinson uses home movie archive to reveal life in 20th Century Britain as never seen before. From the Blitz to the Beatles, the last days of steam trains and working canal boats to royal coronations, these filmmakers captured everything. Each episode is devoted to the decades of the Thirties, World War Two, The Fifties and ending with the roaring Sixties.

name: Doctor Qi, your confused baby is crying again
summary: Jiang Xiaoning is a young girl obsessed with studying. At 21, she has already acquired many diplomas, but she doesn't even think about marriage. Qi Yinli is the heir to the Qi family, dedicated to his career as a doctor, completely indifferent to the opposite sex. Their parents secretly marry them in the hope that the young people will fall in love with each other. But they don't even want to get acquainted, they only want a divorce. But fate has already taken a strong hold of them.

name: Apteeker Melchior
summary: In the year 1422, a series of murders throws the city of Tallinn into turmoil. When the corpse of a knight of the order is desecrated, the young apothecary Melchior Wakenstede, who according to rumour can communicate with the dead, takes over the investigation.

name: Cleaning for a Company
summary: Nan Xing was a carefree college student, until one day, she wakes up and finds that the surrounding environment is very unfamiliar, and she actually works as a cleaner in a company.

name: Empathie
summary: Suzanne, a formerly gifted criminologist and now a psychiatrist, confronts us with our own relationship with empathy. Having had a difficult life herself, her unorthodox methods will shake things up at the Mount Royal Psychiatric Institute, where she lands after being strongly advised to leave the police force.

name: Jään Vangit
summary: An icebreaker is stranded in a winter storm during the longest, darkest Solstice night. Coast Guard Sanna Tanner leads the rescue team haunted by disturbing events. Sanna races to solve the mystery before she becomes the next target.

name: Fawesome Family Game Show
summary: "Fawesome Family Game Show" is a lively quick show where two teams face off in fast-paced classic games with a twist, competing for points and prizes while showcasing creativity, teamwork, and quick thinking.

name: Southern Food Truck Wars
summary: Join host Jay Ducote in the South for a high-stakes food truck showdown! Owners serve their best dishes, battling to become the Southern Food Truck Wars Champion.

name: Taniwha Unleashed: Inside The Chiefs Rugby Club
summary: For the first time, cameras are allowed in to get a unique behind the scenes look at the mighty Chiefs Rugby Club, a breeding ground for international superstars including All Black Damian McKenzie and Black Fern Ruby Tui.

name: Remembers... EastEnders
summary: Actors from the soap remember classic storylines.

previousepisode.name: Angela Wynter and Rudolph Walker Remember... EastEnders: Yolande and Patrick

name: Desired by My Unknown Husband
summary: Frank, a small-town boy, hastily married urbanite Andrew, chosen by his grandmotherly friends, without recognizing each other. Andrew disappeared after going abroad for work. A year later, Frank's boss, the wealthy and charming Andrew, pursued him, leading to an affair. The once-playboy Andrew learned commitment and restraint, while Frank, once betrayed, regained trust and learned to love freely. At the divorce site, Frank discovered his husband and boss were the same person.

name: Mafia Lover
summary: The protagonist, Ace, is a ruthless and decisive mob boss who has firmly established his position at the top of London's underworld. However, during an ambush orchestrated by his archenemy, Jack, a young stranger named Max unexpectedly steps in to save him. This act of bravery sparks Ace's interest and earns his trust. Ace brings Max into his inner circle, seeing him as a valuable ally and even hiring him as his personal bodyguard.

name: Faces of Music
summary: Faces of Music is a documentary series that examines the most exciting musicians today through the lens of beauty and makeup. In each 25-30 minute episode, a featured musician will create a beauty look that has particular meaning for them as an artist. As the transformation unfolds on camera, intimate interviews offer insight into the cultural icons and trends that have shaped each artist's journey.

name: Two Ways with Erica Mena
summary: The ladies and gents are in competition to win over the heart of Erica Mena!

name: Pascagoula 73
summary: Explore the shocking 1973 Pascagoula UFO abduction of Charles Hickson, Calvin Parker and Maria Blair. A gripping tale of extraterrestrial encounters, fear, and resilience that changed their lives forever.

name: The Chosen in the Wild with Bear Grylls
summary: The series follows the cast of the groundbreaking historical drama The Chosen as they take on challenges across forests, deserts, and canyons.  Cast members Jonathan Roumie (Jesus), Paras Patel (Matthew), Elizabeth Tabish (Mary Magdalene), Noah James (Andrew), and Luke Dimyan (Judas) join series creator and executive producer Dallas Jenkins as Bear leads them through Utah's treacherous Castle Valley, Canyonlands, the Ausable River, the Colorado River, the Great Basin Desert, and the Adirondack Forest.

name: Cat Man
summary: The story of a man and a cat named Cheng Bi, in whom the owner sees a person.

name: Witch Watch
summary: Morihito Otogi's friend and witch-in-training, Nico Wakatsuki, moves in. Now it's up to him to protect her.

name: And Then There Were None
summary: 10 men and women are called to the Natural Island Hotel on the isolated island of Heitaijima off Yachijojima by the owner, Nanao Shin. They take the dinner that has been prepared while filled with a mix of expectation and anxiety about what is going to happen and why they have been invited to this island.

name: First Flights with Kate Broug
summary: First Flights with Kate Broug is a documentary series exploring the transformative power of aviation across the globe. Host and pilot Kate Broug takes audiences on a journey across the globe, exploring the extraordinary individuals and daring achievements that have shaped the world of flight as we know it.

previousepisode.name: Frozen in Time: Exploring a Cold War Plane Wreck in Iceland

name: Sam Pang Tonight
summary:
Sam Pang Tonight is a brand-new show defying convention by bringing viewers something refreshingly familiar: a tonight show. Hosted by, you guessed it, Sam Pang.

Sam's no stranger to Aussie audiences, he's buzzed in from the front-right position for more than a decade on the fast and funny Have You Been Paying Attention?, he's hosted the 2023 and 2024 Logie Awards and he's a co-host on Seven's The Front Bar. And now he's got his very own tonight show, filmed in front of a live studio audience.

Expect a monologue that both celebrates and roasts the week's news, a mix of local and international guests, along with plenty of Sam's friends from the comedy world joining in the fun across the eight-episode season.

name: Inside the Four Seasons Park Lane
summary: You are cordially invited to check in for a five star stay at Four Seasons Hotel London at Park Lane! The iconic yet discreet hotel in the heart of London's Mayfair throws open its doors to cameras for the very first time as we learn the secrets of five-star service.

name: Prime Suspect: Hunting the Predators
summary: With unprecedented access, this documentary series enters the dark world of the biggest online predators investigated by the National Crime Agency (NCA).

name: Around the World in First Class
summary: Presenter Josie Gibson goes on an immersive journey into the extraordinary world of first-class travel. The luxury travel sector is exploding and there's a whole new class of clientele keen to sample the very best the planet has to offer in travel decadence.

name: Eva Pau's Asian Kitchen
summary: Join Eva Pau as she takes viewers on a delicious journey through the vibrant world of Asian cuisine.

name: The Role of a Lifetime
summary: A series about how to parent in the rapidly changing world using a Sitcom family to play out parenting challenges which are then explored in the real world.

name: Cybercrimes with Ben Hammersley
summary: Ben Hammersley delves into the dark world of hacking and cybercrime.

name: The Phoenix Team
summary: Two aging spies, one Canadian and one British, who no longer qualify for the top assignments, team up to escape their desk jobs and continue catching the bad guys in their own way.

name: Kopen Of Slopen
summary: Under the guidance of Caroline Tensen, the participants make one last attempt to find a new home. They are assisted for 90 days by real estate agent Alex van Keulen, who goes to great lengths to find their dream home. Meanwhile, architect Britta van Egmond designs a plan to renovate their current home. After 90 days, the participants must choose: buy or demolish?

name: Quinn Country
summary: With unprecedented access to Seán Quinn, the documentary series tells an extraordinary story. It is the story of how a farmer's son from Derrylin on the Fermanagh / Cavan border managed to build an empire from the limestone and shale-filled ground on which he was raised. Charting the dramatic expansion of the Quinn empire, from manufacturing to hospitality, property and insurance, the series details how Seán Quinn became a ‘chieftain' to his native region on the border; injecting employment, wealth and hope into a community which in part, remains fiercely loyal to him today. This series tells how, over the course of his career, Seán Quinn managed to go from school dropout to world the richest man in Ireland…only to lose it all.

name: The Dyers' Caravan Park
summary:
Danny Dyer has tackled a lot in his career - gangsters, geezers, even the Bard himself. But now he's facing his biggest challenge yet: investing in and running a holiday caravan park with his daughter Dani by his side in a brand-new Sky Original six-part series. 

 With childhood nostalgia in his heart and business ambition in his sights, Danny and Dani are diving headfirst into the £7 billion holiday park industry. They'll stop at nothing in their quest to transform a caravan park into a place that lives up to Danny's misty-eyed memories of the best holidays he's ever had in his life.

But this venture is no knees-up at the Queen Vic. Danny will soon discover that running the park is a world away from the life of an A-list actor as he faces everything from dodgy plumbing to demanding punters, rogue acts to reinvigorating the restaurant menu. But will his new business partners, the park's residents or even Dani be on board with his grand, nostalgic vision?

With an unforgettable cast of real-life characters, The Dyers' Caravan Park is a hilarious, heartwarming and occasionally chaotic trip into what really makes the Great British holiday so great.

name: How NOT To Draw
summary: In How NOT To Draw, a drawing tutorial parody series, animators bring beloved Disney characters to life, and the characters bring…CHAOS!

name: Lucía en la telaraña
summary: On April 30, 2008, a woman is found dead in the swimming pool of the farm where her ex-partner was keeping exotic animals confiscated by the Guardia Civil. After a few months, the case was closed. Thus begins the struggle of the victim's sister, Rosa, to obtain justice. A tortuous path that she will undertake together with a former civil guard who will help her to demonstrate the shortcomings of the investigation and to uncover a criminal network that the Internal Affairs Service of the Guardia Civil - appearing for the first time on television in Spain - has called "Operation Spider's Web".

name: Fenjan Albalad
summary: 3 seasons of satirical Palestinian series that reviews social and political issues in a black comedy style.

name: Bali Hai
summary: A famous YouTuber who is heartbroken after his girlfriend left decides to escape to Koh Larn to mend his broken heart. He's thinking his life couldn't get any worse. But then he meets Mac, a working-age man who has just been fired and is struggling with personal issues. The two become friends, and their friendship seems to be going well. However, things take an unexpected turn when they encounter a group of writers who are determined to force them into their imaginative storyline, turning fiction into reality.

name: Offline Love
summary: Ten singles gather in the dreamy city of Nice to find love without any digital devices. Will they find their match with just a paper guidebook and luck?

previousepisode.name: Day 10, 12 a.m. — To the One I Want to Meet Again

name: He Had It Coming
summary:
Elise, an awkward English scholarship student (for the bagpipes, she has the shoulders for it) forms an unlikely alliance with Barbara, a fashion influencer who posts about girl power all day but is always too busy to attend a protest. After a series of mishaps with men, both decide to take a stand. Barbara spearheads an activist art project in the dead of night and drunk as skunks, the girls deface a statue of the university's male founder in the University's Quadrangle.

When the girls wake to discover that the university's star athlete has been murdered and displayed at the foot of their political statement, they must urgently erase all ties to the crime. With Detective Shepherd following the breadcrumbs they have been trying to sweep up, Barbara and Elise need to find the real culprit amid rising gender tensions on campus and a growing body count.

name: Revealed - Death Cap Murders
summary:
A seemingly ordinary family lunch becomes a global media story when four guests fall critically ill, with three later dying. As press from around the world descend on the small country town of Korumburra, Victoria the deaths become a tragic cultural touchstone with wild theories and speculation running rampant. When the lunch host, Erin Patterson, is arrested and charged with triple homicide, the alleged cause of death – poisoning by the world's most lethal mushroom, the death cap - is revealed. 

With exclusive access into one of the highest profile criminal cases in recent memory, the documentary series Death Cap explores how one tragic lunch has the means to shatter a small-town community, while examining the fairness of a trial amidst a global media frenzy.

name: Into the Night
summary: Into the Night is an epic investigation into one of Australia's most baffling crimes. This four part series poses the question – how far would you go to solve a loved one's murder?

name: Dear Life
summary:
A woman, struggling to get over the death of her fiancé, finds comfort in seeking out the recipients of his organs, triggering a tangled chain of connection.

After Ash, a doctor, is attacked by an ice addict, his fiancée Lillian turns off his life support. Months later, Lillian is still reeling in the aftermath of her fiancée's death when she receives a letter from a man crushed by a motorbike, thanking her for his new heart. Suddenly, Lillian feels better. And she wants more of that feeling. She wants to know more about the people that were able to live.

name: Gnomes
summary:
Senior Sergeant Arnold Kipps is having the worst day of his life. His ex-partner and ex-flame Ellie McKay has returned to Nompton to shut down his police station, just as an ancient evil is awakened by the Gnome Queen who unleashes a bloodthirsty horde, plunging the town into chaos.

Now, Arnold and Ellie must reunite to save Nompton from total destruction. With a ragtag team of misfit cops, rebellious teens, and an overly ambitious mayor, they'll take on a growing army of killer gnomes, and try to stop the Gnome Queen's rampage. Because these lawn ornaments aren't just angry. They're out for blood.

name: Watching You
summary: Watching You centres on thrill-seeking paramedic Lina and the fallout of a single decision which threatens to upend her life. Though happily engaged to Cain, a chance encounter with mysterious stranger Dan triggers Lina's desire and culminates in a passionate one-night stand in a WeStay property. In the aftermath, Lina discovers that the affair has been captured by a hidden camera and is blackmailed with the footage. Amid mounting threats and paranoia, she sets out to unmask an insidious voyeur, only to realise that the threat is closer and more dangerous than she could have imagined.

name: Vegas: The City the Mob Made
summary: Las Vegas...Sin City...There is no place like it on earth. The adult playground in the Sun... The country s greatest resort city... the gambling capital of the world...A place of casinos...Home of the famous, and infamous Strip. It is a city where for the right price every kind of entertainment is available for everyone and anyone at any time... It is a city that never sleeps. But it is also a uniquely American city...A Western city ... A desert city. The story of Las Vegas is a 20th century tale...A tale that unites the Mob with the Wild West s culture of cowboys, gunslingers, and saloons. Las Vegas reflects the greater American story of freedom, and the American dream of striking it rich...The last place where you can arrive as a nobody and leave as a king.

name: Gangster Empire: Rise of the Mob
summary: Roam through the dark and smoke filled history of the most ruthless men and family enterprises that changed crime in America! From bootlegs to urban battlefields this groundbreaking series traces the origin of the gangs that dominated criminal activities and invented their own codes of conduct. Meet the legendary figures and discover the real story behind the violence and corruption that pulsed through the soul of the Gangster Empire!

previousepisode.name: The Italian Mob and the real 'Godfathers'

name: Even Though We're Adults
summary: When Ayano, an elementary school teacher in her thirties, runs into a friendly woman, Akari, at favourite bar, sparks begin to fly. As the night comes to a close, Ayano goes in for a kiss, however their new formed connection becomes far more complicated when Akari finds out that Ayano has a husband.

name: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
summary: David Blaine Do Not Attempt follows world-renowned magician and endurance artist David Blaine exploring the world through the lens of magic. David Blaine takes us on a fascinating cultural exchange and a jaw-dropping journey through extraordinary cultures, where he meets with performers and masters - kindred spirits who inspire and share with him exceptional skills (and secrets) - in Brazil, Southeast Asia, India, the Arctic Circle, South Africa and Japan.

name: Pact met de Duivel, In de wurggreep van het Passageproces.
summary: Pact met de Duivel delves into the most extensive and longest-running liquidation case ever in the Netherlands: the Passage trial. What drove the government to collaborate with murderers as crown witnesses? How were the deals made? The precursor to the Marengo trial still raises many questions. Was the trial conducted fairly? Or was it a case of justice being 'too big to fail'?

name: Vivir de Amor
summary: 20 years ago, Elena's family falls apart when her daughter Frida is taken from her and left to die, leaving her alone with Rebeca, her youngest daughter. For 20 years, Rebeca lives a humble life that does not belong to her, until she discovers her true origin and decides to take revenge when she learns that her sister Angelli lived a life full of all the luxuries that she lacked and that, in addition, she is committed to José Emilio. Don Emilio is blinded by his affection for his two grandchildren José Emilio and Misael Aranda, his beloved, who disappoints him for being the cause of a multimillion-dollar fraud that puts the family business at risk. Elena helps her daughter to regain José Emilio's love and, upon discovering Rebeca's perversity, they both decide to face her before she causes them mortal harm. Rebeca and Misael's evil deeds are discovered and they will have to bear the consequences so that, in the end, José Emilio and Angelli can be happy forever.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Quiero vivir de amor para siempre

name: El Conde: Amor y honor
summary: The narrative follows Alejandro, an attractive and bright foreman who rises from rags to riches to avenge those who wronged him. After finding love with Mariana, a beautiful woman from high society, Alejandro becomes the victim of a conspiracy designed to separate them. Wrongfully imprisoned for a crime he did not commit, Alejandro escapes twenty years later, returning as the powerful Count of Montenegro looking for revenge. What unfolds is a dramatic tale filled with passion, treachery, and vengeance.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Siempre hay otra oportunidad

name: American Manhunt: Osama bin Laden
summary: Featuring rare footage and interviews with CIA insiders, this edge-of-your-seat documentary series traces the epic hunt for Osama bin Laden.

name: Boston Blue
summary: In Boston Blue, NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a position with Boston PD. Once in Boston, he is paired with Detective Lena Silver, the eldest daughter of a prominent law enforcement family.

name: The Divorce Insurance
summary: A drama that contains the explicit process of putting a value on divorce, such as developing a new divorce insurance product by an insurance company's innovative product development team, which is comprised of only the best brains, quantifying all matters related to divorce and determining the appropriate insurance amount.

name: Neagley
summary: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military protege of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice. Using everything she's learned from Jack Reacher and her time as a member of the 110 Special Investigators, Neagley puts herself on a dangerous path to uncover a menacing evil.

name: National Theatre Live
summary: Sky Arts presents live stage adaptations of classics.

name: Portugal with Michael Portillo
summary: Portugal is fast becoming the go-to location for Brits to explore and spend their holidays. Not just resorts, villas and golf courses, Portugal's rich and varied locations are attracting millions of us with its year-round sunshine and generous welcome. Now Michael takes us in search of its heart and soul, revealing the secrets of places we know well, and taking us to discover those we don't.

name: Alive
summary: Alive explores disasters that grabbed global headlines for weeks, months, and even years. This show tells the story from the perspective of several separate survivors who had the smarts and the raw human instinct to survive. Each subject tells their complete story of survival, from the peaceful moments beforehand to their triumphant rescue. The stories are deeply personal and emotional accounts of an adventure, sometimes only a few hours in length, that changed their lives in the aftermath.

name: A Perfect Match
summary:
Cheng Tian Xiang, a sunny young man who loves tennis, rescues a young girl, Lin Xiao Ruo, and accidentally meets her cold brother, Lin Xiao Nan, an ice-cold outward appearance and a soft-hearted general manager of an enterprise. Cheng Tian Xiang's innocence gradually melts Lin Xiao Nan's defences, and the two of them move from antagonism to ambiguity, with love quietly sprouting. 

However, the entanglement of old love and the emergence of new love make this relationship full of twists and turns. Will they be able to cross the heart wall and embrace their own happiness?

name: Geleceğe Mektuplar
summary: When a young woman discovers a long-buried secret about her past, she must trace back a collection of letters to their writers to uncover the truth.

name: Manual para señoritas
summary: Hired to find husbands for three wealthy sisters, chaperone Elena Bianda is drawn into a late 19th-century world of love, scandal and comic intrigue.

previousepisode.name: Lección 8: Hacer feliz a tu señorita

name: Maigret
summary: In Maigret, Chief Inspector Maigret and his team of maverick but loyal detectives, Les Maigrets, solve a series of complex crimes in Paris. Maigret's unconventional methods and unique sense of justice put him at odds with his superiors and the judicial system he is supposed to represent. Maigret must outwit some of Paris's most cunning and violent criminals, while dealing with his own troubled past.

name: Megafires The Global Threat
summary: All over the globe, catastrophic wildfires are threatening the climate and our future. This documentary travels the globe to follow the work of a dedicated community of fire experts as they light experimental fires in laboratories, study the history of our forests, and scrutinize the escalating range and impact of the blazes, from hidden smoldering fires deep inside the soil to smoke clouds reaching into the stratosphere. The rediscovery of ancient fire prevention methods as well as large-scale fire experiments pave the way towards possible solutions. How can we learn to live safely with fire in the future?

previousepisode.name: How To Survive On A Burning Planet

name: Order and Disorder: The Forces that Drive the Universe
